snippet.title: STAR SQUADRONS: Galactic Trading Card Game | Gamescom 2026 Trailer | Free Sci-Fi TCG
snippet.description:
WELCOME TO STAR SQUADRONS: GALACTIC TRADING CARD GAME

This trailer was originally created for gamescom 2026 and shows an earlier Alpha build of STAR SQUADRONS. Since then, the game has continued to evolve — including the expansion from three to five contested locations on the battlefield.

PLAY NOW:
https://play.squadrons-game.com/play

NO MANA. NO TRADITIONAL LIFE POINTS. CONSTANT PLAYER INTERACTION.
Choose your opening hand, deploy your ships face down and fight for control across five locations. Positioning, initiative, timing, actions and reactions determine where the real threat lies — and where the battle is won.

RANKED PLAY IS LIVE NOW
We are currently running the Play-2-Claim Test Month, connecting digital gameplay directly with physical STAR SQUADRONS cards. Play at least 20 Ranked matches and qualify for the chance to receive limited physical cards delivered directly to your home.

PLAY FREE
STAR SQUADRONS is currently in active Alpha development and will remain completely free to play for at least one year while the digital and physical game ecosystem continues to expand.

Create your free account, enter Ranked Play and become part of STAR SQUADRONS from the beginning: https://www.squadrons-game.com/enlist/

DIGITAL BATTLES. PHYSICAL REWARDS. ONE CONNECTED TCG UNIVERSE.
